cases.description: unauthorized error, no intention_nodes/parent to resume to -> AUTH_ERROR resumes to null (same result as the old unconditional clear, but now via the resume walk, and reset_process is forced through so Django's resettable merge actually applies the null)

REGRESSION: unauthorized error with a paused parent -> auto-resumes: active_node_id switches to the parent, and the parent's own status flips back to 'active' (it was interrupted by this now-abandoned node in the first place)
unrecognized error text, non-expert -> no message decided here, routed downstream for the agent to interpret instead of a content-free generic fallback
unrecognized error text, expert -> raw text surfaces directly, no interpretation needed
a caller-supplied known code (ALL_CAPS) with its own error_message is preserved as-is, not reclassified or overwritten by the generic table
